explainer_content.short_definition: Seasonal canon where songs return through annual ritual, family memory, media repetition, and holiday atmosphere.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Bing Crosby, Nat King Cole, Vince Guaraldi, Mariah Carey, Trans-Siberian Orchestra, and others show how holiday music renews itself every year.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains music whose meaning depends on calendar timing and shared ritual more than everyday genre allegiance.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The same song can feel dormant for most of the year, then become unavoidable and emotionally charged in season.
